title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Comprehensively and Further Advancing the Pilot Work of the Leniency System for Pleading Guilty and Accepting Punishment in Criminal Cases
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Comprehensively Deepening the Pilot Work of the System for Leniency in Criminal Cases Involving Admission of Guilt and Acceptance of Punishment

Fa [2018] No. 114

High People's Courts of Beijing, Tianjin, Liaoning, Shanghai, Jiangsu, Zhejiang, Fujian, Shandong, Henan, Hubei, Hunan, Guangdong, Chongqing, and Shaanxi Provinces (Municipalities):

The pilot work of the system for leniency in criminal cases involving admission of guilt and acceptance of punishment is a major initiative to implement the reform deployment of the Party Central Committee. Since the launch of the pilot program in November 2016, the people's courts in the pilot areas have earnestly implemented it, with strong organization and leadership, thorough deployment and implementation, and active exploration and innovation, promoting the pilot work to proceed smoothly, steadily, and orderly. Courts in pilot areas such as Beijing, Zhejiang, Fujian, Shandong, Guangdong, Chongqing, and Shaanxi have handled a large number and high proportion of pilot cases, playing a good demonstration and leading role. The pilot courts have formed many successful practices and experiences in terms of substantive handling, procedural application, and supporting safeguards. In December 2017, the 31st Session of the Standing Committee of the 12th National People's Congress reviewed the interim report of the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate on the pilot program, fully affirming the effectiveness of the reform pilot and providing supervisory guidance on the advancement of related work. The Party Leadership Group of the Supreme People's Court attaches great importance to this, and President Zhou Qiang has instructed that the opinions be carefully studied and implemented. With more than half a year left in the pilot program, in order to ensure the successful completion of the reform task, based on the review opinions of the members of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress, and in light of recent progress in the pilot work and research and supervision inspections, the following notice is hereby given on comprehensively deepening the pilot work:

1. Follow the reform principles and ensure correct implementation of the pilot program. It is essential to firmly grasp the reform direction and basic principles to ensure both the legal effect and social effect of case handling. Adhere to the combination of leniency and severity; when imposing sentences, fully consider the social harmfulness of the crime and the personal danger of the defendant, distinguish the nature of the case and the gravity of the offense, ensure that the crime, punishment, and responsibility are proportionate, and avoid the two erroneous tendencies of one-sided severity or one-sided leniency. Implement the requirements of evidentiary adjudication, ensure that the facts established for the case are clear, and the evidence is credible and sufficient, and strictly prevent wrongful convictions such as coerced confessions or taking the blame for others. Effectively safeguard the rights and interests of the parties; while protecting the litigation rights of the defendant, also listen to the opinions of victims in accordance with the law, correctly handle the relationship between compensation and settlement and lenient punishment, and ensure judicial fairness.

2. Strengthen supervision and guidance to ensure the pilot program is standardized and orderly. Relevant high and intermediate people's courts shall strengthen professional guidance and supervise the standardized and orderly conduct of the pilot work. Strictly control the applicable conditions; for cases involving vile criminal nature, cruel criminal methods, serious social harm, and strong public outcry, the application of the system for leniency in cases of admission of guilt and acceptance of punishment shall be exercised with particular caution. Strictly standardize the litigation procedure; in light of the characteristics of cases involving admission of guilt and acceptance of punishment, explore and improve a multi-level trial procedure mechanism for the separation of complex and simple cases, enhance trial efficiency while ensuring case quality, and avoid one-sided simplification or undue haste. Standardize case trial management, improve supervision and restraint mechanisms, and ensure the lawful and impartial exercise of adjudicative power.

3. Strengthen organization and coordination, and focus on solving the difficulties of the pilot work. The reform pilot program has a tight timeframe and heavy tasks. As the reform deepens, deeper-level issues continue to emerge. All localities shall enhance their sense of responsibility, mission, and urgency for the reform pilot, closely rely on the leadership of the Party committee's political and legal affairs committees, proactively and actively coordinate with relevant departments, build consensus, and join forces to solve reform difficulties and promote the in-depth development of the pilot. Strengthen communication and coordination with the procuratorial organs, correctly handle the relationship between the procuratorial organs' sentencing recommendations and the people's courts' sentencing discretion, and explore the improvement of sentencing standards for cases involving admission of guilt and acceptance of punishment. Coordinate to ensure that duty lawyers perform their duties lawfully, provide convenience for lawyers to review case files, and ensure that defendants receive effective legal assistance. Where conditions permit, a mechanism for duty lawyers to be transferred as defense counsel may be explored.

4. Conduct timely research and summary to promote the revision and improvement of relevant legislation. Carry out data analysis and experience sorting of the pilot work, and conduct research and demonstration on further improving the criminal legal system. Treat institutional innovation as a core task, consider and study issues from the institutional level, accumulate experience and prepare for the full rollout of the pilot. Actively cooperate with legislative bodies in conducting research, promptly summarize pilot experiences and practices, transform effective reform practices into institutional mechanisms, and promote the institutionalization and legalization of reform achievements.

Please promptly report the implementation of this notice to the First Criminal Division of the Supreme People's Court.

May 2, 2018
